editorial:
Imagine waking up from the dead with one goal: getting even with the people who ruined your life. You get to follow Eric Draven, a rock star who was killed along with his girlfriend by a nasty gang. Now, he is back as a pale, leather-clad warrior who cannot be killed by bullets or knives. The whole movie feels like a rainy, dark night in a city that never sleeps. It has a cool, edgy style that makes you feel like you are stepping into a comic book. You will really feel for Eric as he hunts down the criminals one by one, making sure they pay for what they did.

Brandon Lee does an amazing job playing Eric, and his performance makes the story feel real. The action is punchy and the dark look of the city is a huge plus, though some parts might feel a bit slow if you just want non-stop fights. If you like dark stories about justice, you need to see this. To get the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or renting it on Apple TV. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call because the colors look stunning.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Eric tracks down the gang leader, Top Dollar, at the top of a building. After a big fight, Eric finally kills him, completing his mission of revenge. Once all the bad guys are gone, Eric's work is done. He says a final goodbye to the memory of his fiancée and lets the crow fly away. He finally finds peace and passes away for good, leaving the world behind.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark superhero stories and gothic style.
